description: This file defines the TwigFilter class, representing a filter within the Twig templating engine. It provides methods to configure and retrieve filter options, safety parameters, and the filter's type.

classes.name: TwigFilter
classes.description: Represents a template filter in Twig, allowing configuration of filter behavior, safety, and compilation options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TwigFilter with a name, callable, and options, setting default options including node class and safety options.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for the filter type, which is 'filter'.

methods.name: getSafe
methods.description: Determines and returns the safety of the filter output based on options and callbacks.

methods.name: getPreservesSafety
methods.description: Returns the safety preservation options for the filter.

methods.name: getPreEscape
methods.description: Retrieves the pre-escape setting for the filter if defined.

methods.name: getMinimalNumberOfRequiredArguments
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of arguments required to call this filter, adding one to the parent's value.
